{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
data = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Convert customer_segment to lowercase for consistency
data['customer_segment'] = data['customer_segment'].str.lower()

# Convert 'revenue' to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
revenue_numeric = pd.to_numeric(data['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Check for non-numeric values after conversion
non_numeric_count = revenue_numeric.isna().sum()
print(f'Number of non-numeric entries in revenue: {non_numeric_count}')

# Now, filter for LOYAL customers and completed orders
filtered_data = data[(data['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & (data['status'] == 'completed')]

# Extract the revenue values for these filtered rows
filtered_revenue = revenue_numeric.loc[filtered_data.index]

# Check for NaN in filtered revenue
nan_in_filtered = filtered_revenue.isna().sum()
print(f'Number of NaN values in revenue for LOYAL completed orders: {nan_in_filtered}')

# Drop NaN values and compute mean
filtered_revenue_clean = filtered_revenue.dropna()
mean_revenue = filtered_revenue_clean.mean()

# Print final result
mean_revenue"}
